verdict.rationale: Terminal itself is a physical/POS payment product requiring a human to present a card, so true autonomous background automation is not its core design; however, related Stripe platform features do enable some background automation — offline payments are automatically queued and forwarded once connectivity returns, webhooks let integrations 'automatically trigger reactions' to events, and Smart Disputes automates evidence collection. These are general Stripe capabilities rather than Terminal-specific agentic automation setup. Missing for 10: a Terminal-specific example of an AI agent configuring/scheduling autonomous POS workflows, and independent/hands-on confirmation that such automations run reliably unattended.
